explanation: The thirteen App-rendering tests await preloadAppViews() in a beforeAll, because App now renders its views as lazy chunks and these tests query them synchronously; lazyView.test.tsx covers the fallback, synchronous render after preload, no remount when the chunk lands, and a failed download that is reported once and retried only on the boundary reset. originHealth.test.ts expects the HEAD probe. compareDownloads.test adds a regression case: the compare-set summary sheet leaves a study's group means blank when that study did not measure the gene.
